recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-39634 unless a future work-group decision reopens whether Device should gain dedicated intended-use or instruction elements.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Change Request asking whether intendedUse or instructionsForUse elements should be added to Device and/or DeviceDefinition. The final resolution was to leave Device unchanged, change DeviceDefinition.guideline.indication, DeviceDefinition.guideline.contraindication, and DeviceDefinition.guideline.warning from CodeableReference to CodeableConcept, and add comments indicating ClinicalUseDefinition can point to DeviceDefinition when more structured data is needed.
initial_application: DeviceDefinition.guideline.usageInstruction and DeviceDefinition.guideline.intendedUse were introduced by earlier FHIR-29728 work. Commit 4f84a83b0dead210ca9182a4090de7273ecae847 applied the FHIR-39634 datatype and per-element comment changes. Follow-up QA cleanup commits 2c438fd7442fa30ca1a54b4b693f5ab44cb702da and d16f598c76ae8d431c38634fc430f26c3f686f0f added and fixed the broader DeviceDefinition.guideline ClinicalUseDefinition comment.
additional_context: OO WGM minutes record the same scope: ClinicalUseDefinition.subject points back to Device and DeviceDefinition, the three DeviceDefinition guideline clinical-use elements should become CodeableConcept, comments should point to ClinicalUseDefinition for structured data, and Device should not change. Device, DeviceDefinition, and ClinicalUseDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current ClinicalUseDefinition.subject targets both Device and DeviceDefinition. Searches found no Zulip discussion or later Jira/community evidence that changes this interpretation; FHIR-31394 was only a separate BR&R ClinicalUseDefinition background issue noted by OO minutes.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml already has CodeableConcept for guideline.indication, guideline.contraindication, and guideline.warning, with ClinicalUseDefinition comments and without ClinicalUseDefinition targetProfile entries. Current source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml has no Device.intendedUse or Device.instructionsForUse element. The existing Device.property text allowing static intended-use or instruction-like characteristics is consistent with the explicit no-change treatment of Device.

related_jiras.note: OO Catalog minutes referenced this separate BR&R ClinicalUseDefinition issue and said to refer to FHIR-39634 for the device-related ClinicalUseDefinition disposition; it was not decided here because it concerns a separate resource family and resolution scope.
